projects.name: SA Financial Crime & Fraud Intelligence Platform
projects.subtitle: Enterprise Cloud Architecture
projects.summary: An enterprise-grade, end-to-end real-time financial crime detection platform built on Microsoft Fabric. Ingests company registrations and sanctions lists through a Medallion architecture, featuring PySpark fuzzy matching and real-time transaction streaming via Eventstream.
projects.outcome: Automated the entire FICA and AML compliance pipeline from raw data ingestion to a real-time fraud alert dashboard.

projects.name: SA Bank DQ & POPIA Pipeline
projects.subtitle: Data Governance & Engineering
projects.summary: Production-grade banking data quality pipeline featuring POPIA-compliant PII masking (SHA-256/UUID), IsolationForest anomaly detection, 8-rule fraud scoring, and Delta Lake Silver storage with a Streamlit dashboard.
projects.outcome: Demonstrated strict data security principles and production-level fault tolerance using a 3-state circuit breaker.

projects.name: InsightOps – E-commerce BI System
projects.subtitle: Data Warehousing & BI
projects.summary: A production-grade Business Intelligence system implementing a Star Schema data warehouse with surrogate keys. It features a full ETL pipeline that transforms raw e-commerce data into actionable KPIs (Revenue, Churn, Profit) and visualizes them on an interactive dashboard.
projects.outcome: Built a scalable dimensional model and automated reporting system, solving real business problems like churn analysis and profit tracking.

projects.name: Vehicle Insurance Fraud Detection
projects.subtitle: Honours Machine Learning Research
projects.summary: Developing an XGBoost machine learning model to classify fraudulent versus legitimate vehicle insurance claims. Focuses on addressing heavy data imbalance and identifying highly correlative claim attributes to optimize predictive metrics like F1-Score and Precision.
projects.outcome: Academic research project addressing the gap in non-linear, tabular feature analysis for insurance fraud.

projects.name: Databricks Medallion Sales Pipeline
projects.subtitle: Cloud Big Data
projects.summary: An end-to-end cloud pipeline processing sales data. Implemented a Bronze (Raw) → Silver (Cleaned) → Gold (Aggregated) workflow using PySpark and Delta Tables to ensure data quality for business reporting.
projects.outcome: Demonstrated mastery of modern Lakehouse architecture principles and disaster recovery using Delta Time Travel.

projects.name: SA Job Market Pipeline & Tracker
projects.subtitle: Advanced ETL & Analytics
projects.summary: A robust daily automated pipeline that aggregates tech jobs from APIs and web scrapers. Implemented a 'Zombie Job' filter to remove expired listings, deduplication logic, and SCD Type 1 storage in PostgreSQL.
projects.outcome: Automated the entire data lifecycle from ingestion to visualization, creating a clean historical dataset of the SA tech market tracking 967+ active jobs.
